# Precedent fixtures

Items the Feedback fixtures of the recorded runs are drawn from. A Feedback fixture is made by hand, never from a model's output, so the property that rests on it holds whatever a re-recording answers.

| File | Document | Feedback fixture |
|---|---|---|
| `pm-meeting-with-chancellor-merz-of-germany-8-october-2026.json` | Readout of the PM's meeting with Chancellor Merz, 8 October 2026, as the GOV.UK Content API returned it on 25 October 2026 | A reaction ("the leaders reaffirmed their unwavering support for Ukraine") made a Development in *UK support for Ukraine* and marked *unwanted* at *following*, for `TestRecordedPlacingPrecedent` |
